fields.mechanism: Incorporation of plant phenolics into polyolefin-based food contact materials to produce active packaging by melt-blending
fields.intervention: Incorporate isobutyl-4-hydroxybenzoate (IBHB) into the ethylene-vinyl alcohol layer of the multilayer polymer film through melt-blending processing
fields.expected_effect: The phenolic compound may alter the polymer matrix structure, potentially reducing moisture plasticization and maintaining barrier properties
fields.falsification_test: Measure water vapor transmission rate of the modified film vs. control over 18 months at 25°C and 65% relative humidity
fields.mechanism_source_span: Therefore, addition of plant phenolics (with low volatility) to different polyolefins might be promising to design active controlled release packaging processed by usual plastic compounding and used for direct contact with food products.
